decision: do not select for FolioPath yet
decision_reasons: Low/default budgets fail recall badly; 100% synthetic recall required a 51.7 second 10k/128-D build.
The existing 100k/512-D exact scan is already below the query latency budget, so ANN complexity is not justified yet.
Import trusts encoded allocation lengths before an application-level bound can be enforced; accidental corruption could cause excessive allocation.
Exports are not byte deterministic and transitive dependency/native dual-architecture closure is not signed off.
caveats: Random-vector recall is not semantic embedding recall.
50k and 100k escalation was intentionally stopped because the 10k candidate did not justify replacing exact scan.
Cross-compilation is not native architecture execution.
